name: A beautiful wedding venue designed as a traditional Greek village
subtitle: Wedding venue in Rhodes
body:
Dreaming of an authentic Greek wedding on Rhodes, surrounded by towering trees, olive groves and fragrant herbs?

This beautiful village-style wedding venue captures the charm of traditional Greece. The grounds feature a small chapel and several little houses where household objects, lovingly preserved by the owners, offer a glimpse into the lives of past generations. The bride and groom each have a separate little house to get ready in.

On the wedding day, guests are treated to melekouni — a traditional Rhodian wedding sweet made with sesame seeds and honey.

The scent of herbs feels like nature’s own aromatherapy. The peaceful surroundings, privacy and beauty invite you to slow down and enjoy every moment.

A place to experience the heart of Greece — and celebrate your love.
title: A beautiful wedding venue designed as a traditional Greek village | Wedding Venues in Greece
description: Explore A beautiful wedding venue designed as a traditional Greek village as a wedding venue for a destination celebration in Greece.

name: A Garden with a Royal Past
subtitle: Wedding venue in Corfu
body:
Just imagine: your wedding in a garden with a royal past…

This palace once served as a residence for the Greek royal family. Picture how life unfolded here: walks along the garden paths, admiring the palace’s impressive architecture and views of the sea…

In this refined, aristocratic atmosphere, one of the most important events of your life could take place — your wedding.

In the luxurious embrace of lush greenery, with elegant neoclassical architecture as your backdrop, you will declare your love for each other and exchange your most heartfelt vows. And the endless azure sea will bear witness to this precious moment in your lives.
title: A Garden with a Royal Past | Wedding Venues in Greece
description: Explore A Garden with a Royal Past as a wedding venue for a destination celebration in Greece.

name: A Hidden Wedding Venue with Two Villas near Chania
subtitle: Wedding venue in Crete
body:
The wedding morning. The bride and groom get ready in their own villas, just a few steps apart. Bridesmaids adjust the dress, friends help fasten cufflinks. Hearts beat faster, and they can hardly wait to see each other.

And then the moment arrives. They see each other and, filled with joy, walk to the ceremony to exchange their most heartfelt vows — surrounded by greenery, with breathtaking sea views.

After the ceremony, the newlyweds and their guests move to the poolside, where a lavish dinner and beautiful décor await. Then comes the first dance, favourite music, and dancing the night away — savouring every moment of their magical day.

What makes this venue special is its two separate villas: one for the bride’s preparations and one for the groom’s. Two wedding mornings that become one shared story.
title: A Hidden Wedding Venue with Two Villas near Chania | Wedding Venues in Greece
description: Explore A Hidden Wedding Venue with Two Villas near Chania as a wedding venue for a destination celebration in Greece.

name: A Little Chapel by the Sea
subtitle: Wedding venue in Rhodes
body:
A white chapel with blue details right by the sea, a picturesque harbour, and little fishing boats at the quay — the Greece you want to capture in your wedding photographs.

Here, the scenery itself becomes the backdrop to your ceremony: sunlight sparkles on the water, the sea stretches to the horizon, and boats gently sway nearby. Every detail brings the charm of a Greek island to your wedding day.

You stand together, sharing the words that mean the most, with the sea and the little chapel behind you. These are the photographs you will treasure — the ones that bring you back to the joy of that day, even years later.
title: A Little Chapel by the Sea | Wedding Venues in Greece
description: Explore A Little Chapel by the Sea as a wedding venue for a destination celebration in Greece.

name: A Mansion of Antiques Among Vines & Olive Groves
subtitle: Wedding venue in Athens
body:
A historic mansion nestled among vineyards and olive groves — a wedding setting for those who appreciate art, history, and the beauty of antiques.

Antique furniture, works of art from a private collection, old books, and objects with stories to tell fill its rooms with timeless charm. These distinctive interiors become part of your wedding décor, adding beauty to every moment.

Begin the evening with a welcome cocktail surrounded by greenery, then invite your loved ones into the mansion for dinner. Beautifully set tables, heartfelt toasts, laughter, and conversation — in a home that invites you to linger and share life’s most precious moments with the people you love.
title: A Mansion of Antiques Among Vines & Olive Groves | Wedding Venues in Greece

name: A Villa by the Ionian Sea
subtitle: Wedding venue in Corfu
body:
Wedding vows against the backdrop of the Ionian Sea, dinner with your loved ones and dancing beneath the stars at a beautiful villa in Corfu — a dream that can become your story.

A pool overlooking the sea, private sea access and spacious grounds allow you to host both your ceremony and wedding celebration here, with privacy and time to savour every moment together.

Nearby is the picturesque chapel of Saint Marina, where you can have a church wedding. After the ceremony, arrive by boat at the villa’s private jetty and greet your guests as newlyweds.
title: A Villa by the Ionian Sea | Wedding Venues in Greece
description: Explore A Villa by the Ionian Sea as a wedding venue for a destination celebration in Greece.

name: A Wedding in an Olive Grove by the Sea
subtitle: Wedding venue in Chalkidiki
body:
On the Kassandra peninsula, between two chapels, lies an olive grove — a beautiful setting for a wedding in Halkidiki. Covering 4,000 m², the grounds are home to fruit-bearing olive trees, with the Aegean Sea just a short walk away.

It feels as though nature itself has prepared this place for your wedding, generously sharing its beauty. Here, you can exchange vows among the olive trees, then gather with your loved ones for a wedding dinner. A stroll to the sea offers a beautiful way to continue your wedding photoshoot.
title: A Wedding in an Olive Grove by the Sea | Wedding Venues in Greece
description: Explore A Wedding in an Olive Grove by the Sea as a wedding venue for a destination celebration in Greece.

name: A Wedding in Blue and White
subtitle: Wedding venue in Chalkidiki
body:
On the Kassandra peninsula, the first “finger” of Halkidiki, an elegant beachfront restaurant sits beside the turquoise sea — a beautiful setting for a symbolic wedding ceremony and reception.

The colours here are simply stunning: soft blues and crisp whites echo the shades of the sky and turquoise sea. Selected areas of the restaurant are decorated with white pebbles and lush green banana plants. The architecture blends naturally into the coastal landscape, creating a space filled with light and understated elegance.

Exceptional dining becomes part of your celebration, with refined dishes, beautiful presentation and attentive service complementing an evening by the sea. The venue’s team will help coordinate the details and tailor the setting and service to your wedding vision, allowing you to enjoy every moment with your loved ones.
title: A Wedding in Blue and White | Wedding Venues in Greece
description: Explore A Wedding in Blue and White as a wedding venue for a destination celebration in Greece.

name: A Wedding with a Cretan Soul
subtitle: Wedding venue in Crete
body:
Crete feels like a country of its own, with its own traditions, cuisine and way of celebrating. A wedding on a traditional Cretan farm is a chance to become part of this life and feel like true Cretans for a day.

At AgrecoFarms, you can exchange your vows beneath azure skies, among olive trees and vineyards, surrounded by the scent of wild herbs. Set on a hillside overlooking the Cretan Sea, this traditional estate offers a beautiful setting for your special ceremony.

Afterwards, gather your loved ones around the table, enjoy local dishes, raise a glass to your life together and celebrate the Cretan way—with warmth, generosity and dancing!
title: A Wedding with a Cretan Soul | Wedding Venues in Greece
description: Explore A Wedding with a Cretan Soul as a wedding venue for a destination celebration in Greece.

name: Beach Wedding in Crete — Say “I Do” by the Sea
subtitle: Wedding venue in Crete
body:
The sound of the waves, a magnificent sunset, the sea breeze and the words of love you share. The scene you have imagined so many times finally comes to life. Your dream of a beach wedding becomes a reality.

The coast of Crete is a beautiful setting for a symbolic wedding ceremony or a vow renewal. Whether it is a ceremony for two or an intimate wedding with your loved ones, let Poseidon himself witness your happiness.
title: Beach Wedding in Crete — Say “I Do” by the Sea | Wedding Venues in Greece

name: Corfiot village wedding
subtitle: Wedding venue in Corfu
body:
Imagine your wedding in a colourful Corfiot village nestled in lush greenery. Vibrant facades, picturesque lanes and authentic details create the feeling of stepping back in time.

The warmth of Greek hospitality and the flavours of traditional cuisine bring your celebration to life. Every dish is prepared in the village’s own kitchens using fresh, organic farm produce.

More than a beautiful setting, this is an invitation to experience the charm of Corfu and share unforgettable moments with the people you love.
title: Corfiot village wedding | Wedding Venues in Greece

name: In the Footsteps of Mamma Mia!: Your Wedding on Skopelos
subtitle: Wedding venue in Skopelos
body:
Say “I do” on the island that provided the backdrop for the famous film Mamma Mia! — a beautiful beginning to your own love story.

Explore the filming locations where Meryl Streep, Pierce Brosnan, Colin Firth and Amanda Seyfried brought the story to life. Feel a touch of Hollywood glamour and become the stars of your own wedding day.

Skopelos enchants far beyond the screen: green hills, pine trees at the water’s edge, picturesque coves and an incredibly turquoise sea. The island’s beauty creates a breathtaking setting for a symbolic or civil wedding ceremony.

Here, you feel as though you have stepped into a beautiful romantic film, while enjoying a true Greek paradise. This time, the story is yours.
title: In the Footsteps of Mamma Mia!: Your Wedding on Skopelos | Wedding Venues in Greece
description: Explore In the Footsteps of Mamma Mia!: Your Wedding on Skopelos as a wedding venue for a destination celebration in Greece.

name: Island Charm on the Athens Riviera
subtitle: Wedding venue in Athens
body:
Some places make it easy to forget how close you are to Athens. Before you lie the sea stretching to the horizon, a rugged coastline and whitewashed walls framed by bougainvillea. Here, on the Athens Riviera, your wedding can capture the island charm of Greece.

The estate brings together several venues, each with its own character: lush gardens, terraces overlooking the sea, poolside settings and intimate corners for a celebration dinner. Olive trees, the scent of lavender and rosemary, natural stone and the soft glow of lanterns create a beautiful setting, ready for your personal touches.

The choice of venue depends on your guest numbers and how you picture your day—from an intimate celebration with your closest loved ones to a grand gathering with dancing late into the evening.
title: Island Charm on the Athens Riviera | Wedding Venues in Greece

name: Kallithea Seaside Wedding
subtitle: Wedding venue in Rhodes
body:
Dreaming of a wedding overlooking the sea, in a place steeped in history?

Designed by Italian architects and opened in 1929, this historic spa complex on Rhodes offers a beautiful setting for your celebration. White archways, an elegant rotunda, intricate pebble mosaics and flowering gardens create a romantic atmosphere overlooking a picturesque bay.

A place where history, architecture and the beauty of the sea become part of your wedding day.
title: Kallithea Seaside Wedding | Wedding Venues in Greece

name: Private Winery
subtitle: Wedding venue in Crete
body: Set among the greenery of northern Crete, this private winery can host anything from an intimate ceremony for two to a large wedding with tens of guests. Traditional Cretan architecture and lush gardens create a beautiful backdrop for contemporary floral decoration, while the botanical garden, barrel rooms and mountain-built cellars offer plenty to explore during a wedding photoshoot. Wine tasting can become part of the day itself, from a private experience to a small reception with selected local wines. After the ceremony, the winery’s own restaurant provides an ideal space for a wedding banquet, keeping the entire event within one remarkable venue.
title: Private Winery | Wedding Venues in Greece
description: Explore Private Winery as a wedding venue for a destination celebration in Greece.

name: Sea Rhapsody in Rhodes
subtitle: Wedding venue in Rhodes
body: Sea Rhapsody — A Wedding by the Aegean Sea Say “I do” on the shores of the Aegean Sea, then take just a few steps to beautifully set tables — this could be your wedding in Rhodes. Here, a seaside ceremony and an elegant restaurant reception come together in one setting, allowing you and your guests to enjoy the celebration without travelling between venues. This taverna has a character all its own, capturing the Greece that makes an island wedding so appealing. With the sea close by, lovely surroundings and a warm atmosphere, it is an inviting place to spend an evening with your loved ones. Mediterranean dishes, heartfelt toasts and conversations around the wedding table make the occasion feel personal. Whether you picture an intimate dinner with your closest friends and family or a larger celebration, the setting can be styled to suit you. Delicate flowers and candlelight can create a romantic mood, while bolder arrangements bring colour and energy to the occasion. For couples dreaming of a wedding by the sea, this venue offers elegance, warmth and the authentic charm of a Greek island.
title: Sea Rhapsody in Rhodes | Wedding Venues in Greece

name: Sea View Wedding Venue in Crete — From Sunset Vows to Dancing Under the Stars
subtitle: Wedding venue in Crete
body:
You hold hands on top of a lush green hill. Before you stretch endless sea views. Look into the distance — on the horizon, the sea kisses the sky. The evening sunset bathes everything in golden light, adding a touch of romance. Lavish flowers and décor complement the natural beauty of the setting and reflect your personal style.

Then comes the moment you have been waiting for: you exchange your wedding vows, fireworks light up the sky, and you hear those long-awaited words: “Congratulations! You are husband and wife!”

This wedding venue in Crete allows you to celebrate your entire day in one place. After your symbolic ceremony, you invite your loved ones to dinner at beautifully set tables. Toasts, laughter and warm wishes lead into your first dance and an evening of dancing under the stars.
title: Sea View Wedding Venue in Crete — From Sunset Vows to Dancing Under the Stars | Wedding Venues in Greece
description: Explore Sea View Wedding Venue in Crete — From Sunset Vows to Dancing Under the Stars as a wedding venue for a destination celebration in Greece.

name: Seaside Wedding by a Charming Church in Crete
subtitle: Wedding venue in Crete
body:
A romantic setting for a wedding in Crete, on a picturesque headland beside a Venetian-era church, partly carved into the rock. Sweeping sea views, a rocky coastline and a small church — this is how you will remember your special day.

Here, you can have an Orthodox wedding or an open-air symbolic ceremony with beautiful sea views. This setting is ideal for an intimate wedding in Greece, a ceremony for two or a celebration with your closest loved ones.

body:
Three unique villas accommodating up to 27 guests — a wonderful choice for a wedding with your nearest and dearest. Each has its own pool and private grounds.

This is your chance to combine your wedding with a holiday. Picture all your loved ones nearby, gathering for dinner, sharing stories and enjoying these happy days together. And a year later, looking back and saying, “Remember when…?”

Olive trees, pines, the scent of pine in the air and the vibrant colours of Skopelos. A little Greek paradise for your love story.

A collection of luxury hotels and wedding venues where authentic Greek hospitality meets refined design and thoughtful attention to detail.

Whitewashed architecture, picturesque bays, and panoramic views of the Aegean Sea. Open-air terraces welcome ceremonies overlooking the sea, followed by elegant dinners bathed in the warm glow of sunset.

The distinctive beauty of Mykonos, exceptional service, and understated luxury lend every celebration a style of its own.

name: The Historic Mansion
subtitle: Wedding venue in Athens
body:
Imagine becoming the owners of a magnificent historic estate for a day…

Begin your wedding day in the mansion’s elegant suite, where you can prepare for your celebration. Then welcome your guests amid fragrant gardens, with a grand mansion and its distinctive tower rising behind you. Panoramic views, the charm of a bygone era and aristocratic elegance create a striking backdrop for your vows.

The celebration continues at the table, with Mediterranean flavours, aromatic herbs and dishes from the mansion’s traditional wood-fired oven. Award-winning executive chefs prepare your chosen menu live, adding a memorable culinary experience to your wedding. From a generous buffet to a refined plated dinner, menus can be tailored to your tastes, dietary needs and religious requirements.

High standards and personalised service bring every element together, turning your vision into a celebration that feels entirely your own.

Located within a hotel, this wedding venue gives you the freedom to settle in, relax and enjoy every moment of your special day, with your stay and celebration in one beautiful place.
